verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents background automation within its compliance domain. Users can enable per-customer ongoing monitoring via the API, and Mesh agentic workflows auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases, with results delivered through webhooks. It is not a general user-defined automation builder, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules, triggers and schedules; detailed first-party docs on configuring the agents; independent or hands-on corroboration that the agents run autonomously.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
